verses.gurmukhi: ਜਲ ਵਿਚਿ ਕਵਲੁ ਅਲਿਪਤੁ ਹੈ ਸੰਗ ਦੋਖ ਨਿਰਦੋਖ ਰਹੰਦਾ।
verses.translit_en: jal vich kaval alipat hai sa(n)g dhokh niradhokh raha(n)dhaa|

en.bdb: The lotus residing in water remains unsmeared by it.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਾਤੀ ਭਵਰੁ ਲੁਭਾਇਦਾ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਸੁਗੰਧਿ ਮਿਲੰਦਾ।
verses.translit_en: raatee bhavar lubhaidhaa seetal hoi suga(n)dh mila(n)dhaa|

en.bdb: In the night it attracts the black bee which gets coolness and fragrance from lotus.

verses.gurmukhi: ਭਲਕੇ ਸੂਰਜ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਧਰਿ ਪਰਫੁਲਤੁ ਹੋਇ ਮਿਲੈ ਹਸੰਦਾ।
verses.translit_en: bhalake sooraj dhiaan dhar parafulat hoi milai hasa(n)dhaa|

en.bdb: In the morning it again meets the sun and being glad smiles the whole day.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖੁ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਸਹਜਿ ਘਰਿ ਵਰਤਮਾਨ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਵਰਤੰਦਾ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh sukh fal sahaj ghar varatamaan a(n)dhar varata(n)dhaa|

en.bdb: Gurmukhs (like lotus) reside in the innate house of pleasure fruit and utilise the present time fully i.e. they don't sit idle.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲੋਕਾਚਾਰੀ ਲੋਕ ਵਿਚਿ ਵੇਦ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੰਦਾ।
verses.translit_en: lokaachaaree lok vich vedh veechaaree karam kara(n)dhaa|

en.bdb: To the ordinary people busy in mundane affairs they look engrossed in the world, and, to the people pondering over Vedas they look engaged in rituals.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਵਧਾਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਵਿਚਿ ਜੀਵਨਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਵਿਚਰੰਦਾ।
verses.translit_en: saavadhaan gur giaan vich jeevan mukat jugat vichara(n)dhaa|

en.bdb: But these gurmukhs, as a result of attaining knowledge from the Guru, keep consciousness in their possession and move in the world as liberated ones.
In the congregation of the holy person resides the Guru-word.
